roadmap.name: Habit Builder Integration
roadmap.summary: Integrate the Habit-Builder repository as a "/habits" page within Body-Metrics-Tracker. Both repos share similar tech stacks (React, Wouter, TailwindCSS, shadcn/ui, Drizzle, Express). Key challenges: React 18 vs 19, TailwindCSS 3 vs 4, merging schemas, route nesting.

phase.name: Phase 1: Schema & Database
phase.description: Merge Habit-Builder database schema into Body-Metrics-Tracker

task.title: Analyze Habit-Builder schema
task.description: Review shared/schema.ts from Habit-Builder to understand tables (habits, habit_entries, etc.)

task.title: Add habit tables to shared/schema.ts
task.description: - Add habits table (id, patientId, name, frequency, color, icon, createdAt, etc.) - Add habitEntries table (id, habitId, date, completed, note, etc.) - Add relations linking habits to patients (existing user model)

task.title: Create Zod validation schemas
task.description: Add habit-related Zod schemas (createHabitSchema, habitEntrySchema) to shared/

task.title: Run database migration
task.description: Execute npm run db:push to create new habit tables

phase.name: Phase 2: Backend API Routes
phase.description: Add Express routes for habit CRUD operations

task.title: Add habit storage methods
task.description: Extend IStorage interface and DatabaseStorage class with: - getHabits(patientId) - getHabit(habitId) - createHabit(data) - updateHabit(habitId, data) - deleteHabit(habitId) - getHabitEntries(habitId, dateRange) - toggleHabitEntry(habitId, date)

task.title: Create habit API routes
task.description: Add to server/routes.ts: - GET /api/habits (list user's habits) - POST /api/habits (create habit) - GET /api/habits/:id (get single habit with entries) - PUT /api/habits/:id (update habit) - DELETE /api/habits/:id (delete habit) - POST /api/habits/:id/entries (toggle entry for date) - GET /api/habits/:id/stats (streak, completion rate)

task.title: Add route validation
task.description: Wire up Zod schemas for request validation on all habit endpoints

phase.name: Phase 3: Frontend - Hooks & API Layer
phase.description: Create React Query hooks for habit data fetching

task.title: Create use-habits.ts hook file
task.description: New hook file with: - useHabits() - fetch all habits - useHabit(id) - fetch single habit with entries - useCreateHabit() - mutation - useUpdateHabit() - mutation - useDeleteHabit() - mutation - useToggleHabitEntry() - mutation - useHabitStats(id) - fetch streak/stats

task.title: Define API query keys
task.description: Add habit query keys to queryClient pattern (api.habits.*)

phase.name: Phase 4: Frontend - Components
phase.description: Port and adapt UI components from Habit-Builder

task.title: Audit Habit-Builder components
task.description: List all components in Habit-Builder/client/src/components/: - Identify reusable vs page-specific components - Check for naming conflicts with existing components - Note TailwindCSS v4 syntax that needs v3 adaptation

task.title: Create habits component directory
task.description: Create client/src/components/habits/ for habit-specific components

task.title: Port HabitCard component
task.description: Adapt styling from TailwindCSS v4 to v3, update imports

task.title: Port HabitForm component
task.description: Form for creating/editing habits with react-hook-form

task.title: Port HabitCalendar/Grid component
task.description: Visual grid showing habit completion (GitHub-style contribution graph)

task.title: Port StreakDisplay component
task.description: Shows current streak, best streak, completion percentage

task.title: Adapt framer-motion animations
task.description: Ensure animations work with framer-motion v11 (downgrade from v12 syntax if needed)

phase.name: Phase 5: Frontend - Pages
phase.description: Create habit pages and integrate into router

task.title: Create HabitsHome page
task.description: Main habits dashboard at /habits showing: - List of all habits with today's status - Quick toggle for today's entries - Summary stats (total habits, today's completion) - "Add Habit" button

task.title: Create CreateHabit page
task.description: Page at /habits/new with form to create new habit: - Name, description, frequency (daily/weekly/custom) - Color picker, icon selector - Reminder settings (optional)

task.title: Create HabitDetail page
task.description: Page at /habits/:id showing: - Habit info and edit button - Calendar view of entries - Streak and statistics - Entry history list - Delete option

task.title: Add routes to App.tsx
task.description: Add protected routes: - /habits → Habits (list) - /habits/new → CreateHabit - /habits/:id → HabitDetail

task.title: Add navigation link
task.description: Add "Habits" link to sidebar/navigation component

task.title: Verify TailwindCSS class compatibility
task.description: TailwindCSS v4 uses CSS-first config, v3 uses JS config. Audit all ported components for: - @apply usage differences - Color palette references - Animation classes

task.title: Match existing design system
task.description: Ensure habit pages match Body-Metrics-Tracker visual style (colors, spacing, cards)

task.title: Add loading states
task.description: Add skeleton loaders consistent with existing pages

task.title: Add error handling
task.description: Toast notifications for errors, empty states for no habits

task.title: Manual E2E testing
task.description: Test full flow: - Create habit - Toggle entries - View stats - Edit habit - Delete habit

task.title: Add API tests
task.description: Add habit endpoint tests to server/routes.test.ts

task.title: Update CLAUDE.md
task.description: Document new habit feature in project documentation

task.title: Archive/delete Habit-Builder repo
task.description: Once verified working, the standalone Habit-Builder repo can be archived

dependency.reason: Schema must exist before storage methods
API routes must exist before hooks
Routes must be wired before testing

risk.title: React version mismatch
risk.description: Habit-Builder uses React 19, Body-Metrics-Tracker uses React 18. Some React 19 features may need adjustment.
risk.mitigation: Avoid React 19-specific APIs (use(), Actions). Standard hooks work in both.

risk.title: TailwindCSS config differences
risk.description: v4 uses CSS-based config, v3 uses JS config. Class names mostly compatible but @layer/@apply may differ.
risk.mitigation: Port styles manually, verify each component renders correctly.

risk.title: Component naming conflicts
risk.description: Both repos use shadcn/ui. Custom components may share names.
